βαλόντες: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having thrown’ · also aor. part. masc. nom. pl., ‘having put’ (ἐν νηῒ … βαλόντες ‘having put aboard a ship’)
βαῖν: βαίνω — go, walk, step; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (βαῖν’ = βαῖνε), tmesis ἀνέβαινε ’was going aboard’ · also in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐκβαίνω ’was stepping out’
δαρδάπτουσιν: δαρδάπτω — devour, tear up; pres. 3 pl., ν-movable
δείλ: δειλός — wretched, miserable; masc. voc. sg., elided (δείλ’ = δείλε), in the exclamation ἆ δείλε
θανόντι: θνῄσκω — die; aor. part. dat. sg.: ’(for him) dead’
θοὸν: θοός — swift; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with βέλος (masc. acc. sg. also): ’swift’
λιγυρῇ: λιγυρός — clear-toned, shrill, sweet-sounding; fem. dat. sg. (with ἀοιδῇ)
νέρθεν: νέρθεν — from beneath, below; adv.: ’beneath the earth’
νέων: νέος — young; masc. gen. pl. · also a different word, νέω ’swim’: pres. part. masc. nom. sg., ’swimming’
νευρῆς: νευρή — bowstring, string; fem. gen. sg., object of πειράω (+ gen.): ’the string’
πάθῃσιν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. subj. 3 sg. in -ῃσι, epic (= Attic πάθῃ)
παῦσεν: παύω — stop, check; aor. 3 sg., transitive
ποικιλομήτην: ποικιλομήτης — of shifting, many-colored cunning (ποικίλος + μῆτις); masc. acc. sg., epithet of Odysseus
πτερὰ: πτερόν — feather, wing; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., predicate: ’wings’ (τά τε πτερὰ νηυσὶ πέλονται ’which are wings for ships’)
πόδεσσι: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ποσί)
ταλασίφρονος: ταλασίφρων — enduring-minded, steadfast; gen. sg. (epithet of Odysseus, from τλῆναι ’endure’)
φθῆ: φθάνω — be first, forestall; aor. 3 sg., epic root aorist, unaugmented (= Attic ἔφθη): ’got there first’
ἀΐοντες: ἀΐω — hear, perceive (+ gen.); pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’hearing’
ἄλλυδις: ἄλλυδις — in one direction, elsewhere; adv. (ἄλλυδις ἄλλη ’each a different way’)
ἆ: ἆ — ah!, oh!; interjection of dismay or reproach
ἐξοπίσω: ἐξοπίσω — hereafter, in time to come; adv.
ἐπεύξατο: ἐπεύχομαι — pray to, vow; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’prayed’
ἐπιμὶξ: ἐπιμίξ — in confusion, mixed together; adv. (cf. μίγνυμι)
ἐσχατιῇ: ἐσχατιή — the furthest point, edge, border; dat. sg.
ἔπαυσας: παύω — make cease, stop; aor. 2 sg., + gen.: ’you made me cease from’
ἔφερον: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented: ’they carried’ · also impf. 1 sg. (same form)
ἤλασεν: ἐλαύνω — drive; also strike, deal a blow; aor. 3 sg., augmented (unaugmented ἔλασεν): ’drove, struck’
ἰητρὸς: ἰατρός — physician, healer; masc. nom. sg., Ionic ἰητρός (= Attic ἰατρός)
ὁμίλει: ὁμιλέω — keep company with, associate with; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, + dat. · also pres. imper. 2 sg., + dat., the identical unaugmented form: ’mingle, keep company with!’ (μνηστῆρσιν ὁμίλει)
ὁμιλέομεν: ὁμιλέω — keep company, be together, throng; pres. 1 pl., epic uncontracted -έομεν (= Attic ὁμιλοῦμεν)
ὑποστρέψας: ὑποστρέφω — turn back, return; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having turned back’
